global_rules: No install/download/API/model execution without explicit execution.
Never store API-key values in return bundles.
Runtime/resource failure = UNTESTED_RESOURCE_TRANSPORT, never negative scientific evidence.
No synthetic substitute may be promoted as external evidence.
All source pins and data hashes must be recorded before scientific verdicts.
Gamma live-provider work is excluded and remains explicit-human-grant gated.
